final_message:
I've finished the Agent's counter-turn and the cover note to Thomas Kuo. Both files pass the docx validator and read back cleanly.

The redline is marked against MDLLP's markup with all their changes taken as accepted, so rejecting our changes gives you their draft and accepting them gives you ours. It has 123 tracked changes and 27 margin comments (WCS-0 to WCS-26) giving our position on each point. Of the 40 MDLLP changes and requests, we accept 9, counter-propose on 11, and reject or decline 20. Most of the rejections rest on the executed Credit Agreement, which the Guarantor signed as "acknowledged by":
- **Post-acceleration notice carve-out and 5-day demand grace period:** rejected. Section 7.02 says no further notice to the Guarantor is needed and the Guaranty is enforceable immediately on acceleration.
- **Termination right, reinstatement limit, immediate subrogation, marshaling and election-of-remedies deletions, jury waiver deletion:** rejected. Exhibit F (the agreed form of guaranty), the Term Sheet and Credit Agreement Sections 9.01 and 9.05 require them.
- **Net-worth liability cap:** replaced with a standard fraudulent-transfer savings clause. The cap would shrink to near zero when the group is in distress, and this is a parent guaranteeing its own subsidiary, so that risk is low.
- **Counter-offers:**
  - payment-only guaranty, with clarifying language on what it covers;
  - New York statute of limitations, with accrual on demand;
  - intercompany payment block triggered only by an Event of Default (or by a blockage notice during a lesser Default);
  - courtesy copies of default notices;
  - damages waiver kept alongside the jury waiver;
  - Guarantor consent only for amendments that increase its obligations.

Things you should know before this goes out:
- **No embedded comments in the markup.** The [TK1]–[TK10] comments the email refers to aren't in the file. I responded to them from the email's descriptions, and the cover note says so.
- **Mixed markup conventions.** Their markup mixed real tracked changes with typed "[DELETED: …]" and "[ADDED: …]" text. I treated all of it as proposed changes.
- **Undefined term.** MDLLP used "Excluded Swap Obligations" without defining it; I added the standard definition and a matching eligible-contract-participant representation (new 6.7).
- **Our own cross-reference error.** Section 12.1 of our June 16 draft (and their new paragraph) pointed to Credit Agreement 9.04 for assignments; the right section is 9.06. Both are fixed.
- **Notice emails don't match.** Diana Chow's email appears three different ways across the Guaranty, the Credit Agreement and the transmittal, and Thomas Kuo's differs between the Guaranty and the Credit Agreement. I flagged these for confirmation rather than changing them.
- **Compliance certificate figures.** The leverage (2.45x) and interest coverage (5.80x) figures I cite come from the Credit Agreement's form of compliance certificate (Exhibit C), dated after the mark
